infobox.usage: Unlocks the ZB-1013 extraction on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: ZB-1013 key (ZB-1013) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key engraved with letters "ZB-013" that opens the metal door beneath the unfinished construction site in the Customs terminal industrial area, nicknamed "Fortress" by the locals.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door leading to the ZB-1013 extraction in the basement of the Scav base on Customs.
